works.idea_en: When mobility becomes informational, the interface might be a living organism on the body.
works.idea_zh: 当移动变成信息的移动，界面也许是一个附在身上的活体。
works.method: Speculative design film with a prop device made for the En Vie / Alive exhibition.
works.method_zh: 为 En Vie / Alive 展览制作的思辨设计影片与道具装置。

works.title: Botanical Factory
works.description: A design and botany workshop between ENSCI Les Ateliers and Central Saint Martins that grew product parts from plants, shown as a production chain of electronic objects with bodies moulded from gourds.
works.description_zh: ENSCI Les Ateliers 与 Central Saint Martins 合办的设计与植物学工作坊，用植物长出产品部件，展出一条外壳由葫芦模塑而成的电子产品生产线。
works.idea_en: Produce without altering genes: steer plant growth and follow the seasons instead.
works.idea_zh: 不改基因也能生产：引导植物生长，并顺应季节。
works.method: Horticultural techniques such as growing gourds inside moulds shape the plant into a housing, harvested by season and fitted with electronics.
works.method_zh: 用园艺手法（如让葫芦在模具中生长）把植物塑造成外壳，按季节收获后装入电子元件。

works.title: Banana Bacteria
works.description: An olfactory installation of flasks of E. coli engineered to lose their usual foul smell and produce the scent of banana oil instead.
works.description_zh: 一件嗅觉装置：烧瓶里的大肠杆菌被改造得不再发出通常的臭味，而是散发香蕉油的气味。
works.idea_en: Changing how a microbe smells changes how we feel about it.
works.idea_zh: 改变微生物的气味，就改变了我们对它的感受。
works.method: Uses the MIT iGEM 2006 BioBrick (BBa_J45250) in an odourless knockout strain; adding isoamyl alcohol lets the bacteria convert it to isoamyl acetate, the banana-scented ester.
works.method_zh: 在无味的基因敲除菌株中使用 MIT 2006 年 iGEM 团队的 BioBrick（BBa_J45250）；加入异戊醇后，细菌把它转化为带香蕉味的酯类乙酸异戊酯。

works.title: The New Weathermen
works.description: Test rigs and small experiments attributed to a fictional eco-activist group that uses synthetic biology to force radical environmental change, blurring activism and crime.
works.description_zh: 一组试验装置和小型实验，归于一个虚构的环保激进团体：他们用合成生物学强行推动激进的环境变革，模糊了行动主义与犯罪的界限。
works.idea_en: Synthetic biology tools can serve ideology, including activist ideology.
works.idea_zh: 合成生物学工具也可以为意识形态服务，包括激进行动的意识形态。
works.method: Design fiction built from DIY-biology equipment and props that hint at larger plans, drawing on biopunk, open-science and Anonymous-style networks.
works.method_zh: 用 DIY 生物学设备和道具构建的设计虚构，暗示更大的计划，借鉴生物朋克、开放科学和类似 Anonymous 的网络组织。

works.title: All That I Am
works.description: Hair said to be Elvis Presley's, bought on eBay, is sequenced and used to order transgenic 'Elvis mouse models', which are shown in cages staging episodes of his life, such as a distorting mirror for fame.
works.description_zh: 从 eBay 买到据称属于猫王的头发，送去测序，再据此订购转基因“猫王小鼠模型”，把它们放进重现他人生片段的笼子里，比如代表名声的哈哈镜。
works.idea_en: Three online services are enough to turn a celebrity's hair into made-to-order animals.
works.idea_zh: 三个网上服务就足以把一位名人的头发变成定制动物。
works.method: Chains commercial DNA sequencing, trait analysis and transgenic mouse-model services; the cages are designed environments that mirror nurture alongside nature.
works.method_zh: 串联商业 DNA 测序、性状分析和转基因小鼠模型定制服务；笼子是设计出来的环境，在“先天”之外呈现“后天”。

works.title: Blighted by Kenning
works.description: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was encoded into bacterial DNA, which was then used to 'contaminate' apples grown in The Hague; the fruit was sent to genomics labs worldwide, whose scientists were asked to decode the message and eat the apple.
works.description_zh: 把《世界人权宣言》编码进细菌 DNA，再用它“污染”海牙种的苹果；这些苹果被寄往世界各地的基因组实验室，请科学家解码其中的信息并吃掉苹果。
works.idea_en: A text hidden in DNA turns a piece of fruit into a forbidden, readable message.
works.idea_zh: 藏在 DNA 里的文字，把一只水果变成一条既禁忌又可读的信息。
works.method: Each letter is written as one DNA codon, using the amino-acid single-letter code with a few reassigned codons for spaces and letters without amino acids; the DNA is extracted from bacteria and applied to the apples.
works.method_zh: 每个字母写成一个 DNA 密码子，采用氨基酸单字母代码，并为空格和没有对应氨基酸的字母重新指定几个密码子；DNA 从细菌中提取后涂到苹果上。

works.title: Zero Park
works.description: A narrated diaphanorama of a restored wilderness in northern California that, as the narrator talks, turns out to be an engineered ecosystem designed to produce rocket fuel for a private spaceflight.
works.description_zh: 一幅配有旁白的透光画（diaphanorama），描绘北加州一片恢复后的荒野；随着旁白推进，观众发现这其实是一个工程生态系统，被设计来为私人航天飞行生产火箭燃料。
works.idea_en: The same landscape can be conservation and industrial infrastructure at once.
works.idea_zh: 同一片风景，可以同时是自然保护区和工业基础设施。
works.method: A 19th-century diaphanorama device combines a translucent landscape image with changing light and a voice-over whose speaker could be naturalist, synthetic biologist or tech CEO.
works.method_zh: 借用 19 世纪的透光画装置，把半透明风景图与变化的光线和旁白结合；说话人可能是博物学家、合成生物学家，也可能是科技公司 CEO。

works.title: The Mechanism of Life – After Stéphane Leduc
works.description: Tissue Culture & Art Project restage Stéphane Leduc's 1911 osmotic-growth experiments with a machine that prints protocell-like forms, which grow and then dissolve back into the liquid.
works.description_zh: Tissue Culture & Art Project 重演 Stéphane Leduc 1911 年的渗透生长实验：一台机器打印出类似原细胞的形态，它们生长后又溶回液体中。
works.idea_en: Today's protocell hype repeats century-old claims that life is only chemistry.
works.idea_zh: 今天对原细胞的热捧，重复着一百年前“生命只是化学”的论调。
works.method: Uses one of Leduc's simplest diffusion and osmosis protocols, in which metal-salt crystals dropped into a solution such as sodium silicate form semi-permeable membranes that grow into cell- and plant-like shapes; made with Corrie van Sice.
works.method_zh: 采用 Leduc 最简单的扩散与渗透方案之一：盐晶体在硅酸盐溶液中形成半透膜，长成类似细胞和植物的形状；与 Corrie van Sice 合作完成。

works.title: Hack the Root
works.description: An architectural structure of mycelium panels grown on agricultural waste, commissioned for RIBA North in Liverpool with an exhibition and events programme, later shown at Somerset House.
works.description_zh: 一座由生长在农业废弃物上的菌丝体板材构成的建筑结构，受利物浦 RIBA North 委托，配有展览和活动项目，之后在萨默塞特宫展出。
works.idea_en: Agricultural by-products and fungi can become a local, low-carbon building material.
works.idea_zh: 农业副产品加上真菌，可以变成本地的低碳建材。
works.method: Fungal mycelium is grown through agro-waste substrates in moulds, forming rigid bio-composite panels that are dried and assembled into the structure.
works.method_zh: 让真菌菌丝体在模具中长透农业废料基质，形成坚硬的生物复合板，干燥后拼装成结构。

works.title: Growing Shoes
works.description: Shoe prototypes grown from fungal mycelium, made for the Fungal Futures exhibition by Officina Corpuscoli and Utrecht University and later shown at Somerset House.
works.description_zh: 由真菌菌丝体长成的鞋子原型，为 Officina Corpuscoli 与乌得勒支大学的 Fungal Futures 展制作，后来在萨默塞特宫展出。
works.idea_en: A shoe can be grown to shape rather than cut, stitched and glued.
works.idea_zh: 一双鞋可以按形状长出来，而不是裁剪、缝合和粘接。
works.method: Mycelium is grown on agricultural substrate inside shoe-shaped moulds, then heat-dried to stop growth; tested for different parts of the shoe.
works.method_zh: 让菌丝体在鞋形模具中的农业基质上生长，再加热干燥以终止生长；并测试用于鞋的不同部位。

works.title: The Mycological Twist
works.description: A mushroom garden that began in 2014 as an extension of the Jupiter Woods gallery garden in London and later moved to Athis-Mons near Paris, around which the artists run commissioned works, lectures and performances timed to inoculation, growth and harvest.
works.description_zh: 一座蘑菇花园：2014 年作为伦敦 Jupiter Woods 画廊花园的延伸开始，后迁往巴黎附近的阿蒂-蒙斯；艺术家围绕它按接种、生长和采收的节奏安排委托作品、讲座和表演。
works.idea_en: Let the life cycle of fungi set the calendar of an art programme.
works.idea_zh: 让真菌的生命周期来决定艺术项目的日程。
works.method: Permacultural cultivation of edible and wild fungi on substrates in and around exhibition spaces; events such as the film Ghost Camp grow out of the garden's cycles.
works.method_zh: 在展览空间内外用基质进行食用菌和野生真菌的朴门式栽培；影片《Ghost Camp》等活动都从花园的周期中生长出来。

works.title: Half Life Lamp
works.description: A lamp whose light source is a culture of genetically modified cells that glow when fed their substrate, made with the University of Twente.
works.description_zh: 一盏灯，光源是一团转基因细胞培养物，喂给底物后会发光；与特文特大学合作制作。
works.idea_en: A product could be alive, need care and eventually die, instead of using electricity.
works.idea_zh: 产品可以是活的：需要照料、最终会死去，而不是靠电运转。
works.method: A Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line carrying the firefly luciferase gene emits light when the substrate luciferin is added.
works.method_zh: 携带萤火虫荧光素酶基因的中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞系，在加入底物荧光素后发光。

works.title: Semi-Human Vase
works.description: A 3D-printed vase-shaped scaffold cultured with patches of human cells, stained blue, made with tissue engineers at TU Eindhoven and shown at the Centre Pompidou.
works.description_zh: 一个 3D 打印的花瓶形支架，上面培养着一块块染成蓝色的人类细胞，与埃因霍温理工大学的组织工程研究者合作完成，并在蓬皮杜中心展出。
works.idea_en: An everyday object made partly of human tissue blurs the line between body and product.
works.idea_zh: 一件部分由人体组织构成的日常物件，模糊了身体与产品的界限。
works.method: Human cells are seeded onto a 3D-printed mould in the lab of Patricia Dankers with Dan Jing Wu, grown in culture and then stained to make them visible.
works.method_zh: 在 Patricia Dankers 实验室与 Dan Jing Wu 合作，把人类细胞接种到 3D 打印模具上培养，再染色使其可见。

works.title: Capacity for (Urban Eden, Human Error)
works.description: A robotic bioprinter that deposits living plant tissue in patterns based on urban forms, run live during the exhibition so the printed patterns grow and change daily.
works.description_zh: 一台机器人生物打印机，按照城市形态的图案沉积活体植物组织，在展期内现场运行，使打印出的图案每天都在生长变化。
works.idea_en: Printing living cells hands the final form over to growth, and to error.
works.idea_zh: 打印活细胞，就是把最终形态交给生长，也交给误差。
works.method: A custom robotic printer lays down plant cells (likely moss or tobacco culture) in a nutrient gel along computed patterns; the cultures then grow in a sealed chamber.
works.method_zh: 定制的四轴打印机沿计算好的图案，把植物细胞（可能是苔藓或烟草培养物）铺进营养凝胶；随后这些培养物在密封舱中生长。

works.title: Habitáculos Orgánicos
works.description: A series of printed micro-architectures for microorganisms, colonised by microbes collected in public space, with measuring devices that record how they inhabit and transform the structures.
works.description_zh: 一组为微生物打印的微型建筑，由在公共空间采集的微生物定居，并配有测量装置，记录它们如何栖居并改造这些结构。
works.idea_en: Design housing for microbes to see the city as a living organisation.
works.idea_zh: 为微生物设计住所，把城市看成一个活的组织。
works.method: Culture media are formulated as printable material and extruded into small architectural forms, then inoculated with urban microorganisms and monitored with custom electronics.
works.method_zh: 把培养基配成可打印材料，挤出成小型建筑形态，再接种城市微生物，并用自制电子设备监测。

works.title: Pink Chicken Project
works.description: A proposal to use a CRISPR gene drive to turn the bones and feathers of every chicken on Earth pink, so that the fossil marker of the Anthropocene left by some 60 billion slaughtered chickens a year becomes a pink line in the rock strata.
works.description_zh: 一个提案：用 CRISPR 基因驱动让地球上所有鸡的骨骼和羽毛变成粉色，使每年约 600 亿只被宰杀的鸡在地层中留下的人类世化石标记变成一条粉色的线。
works.idea_en: Gene editing could be used for a geological-scale protest gesture.
works.idea_zh: 基因编辑可以被用来做一个地质尺度的抗议姿态。
works.method: Proposes inserting a gene from the cochineal insect whose pigment binds with bone calcium and fossilises, spread through the species with a gene drive, plus a manifesto encoded in the chickens' DNA; developed with a synthetic biology lab and taken to the UN CBD COP-14 (2018).
works.method_zh: 设想插入来自胭脂虫的基因，其色素与骨钙结合并可石化，再用基因驱动在整个物种中扩散，同时把一份宣言编码进鸡的 DNA；与一家合成生物学实验室合作开发，并于 2018 年带到联合国《生物多样性公约》COP-14 会场。

works.title: Silk Poems
works.description: A poem about silk, written in a six-character chain like the protein's structure, nanoimprinted on a transparent silk-film biosensor designed to be implanted in the body.
works.description_zh: 一首关于蚕丝的诗，按照丝蛋白结构写成六字符链，纳米压印在一片设计用于植入人体的透明蚕丝薄膜生物传感器上。
works.idea_en: Silk is biocompatible, so a poem on silk could be read inside a body.
works.idea_zh: 蚕丝具有生物相容性，所以写在蚕丝上的诗可以在身体里被“阅读”。
works.method: Developed with silk materials scientists (Fiorenzo Omenetto's Silk Lab at Tufts): regenerated Bombyx mori silk fibroin is cast into film and the text is imprinted at nanoscale.
works.method_zh: 与蚕丝材料科学家（塔夫茨大学 Fiorenzo Omenetto 的 Silk Lab）合作：把再生家蚕丝素蛋白浇铸成薄膜，再以纳米尺度压印文字。

works.title: Algae Powered Thermometer
works.description: An installation in which containers of three algae species act as photo-microbial fuel cells that together power an electric thermometer.
works.description_zh: 一件装置：装着三种藻类的容器充当光合微生物燃料电池，共同为一支电子温度计供电。
works.idea_en: A 'biological solar panel' can run a small everyday instrument.
works.idea_zh: “生物太阳能板”可以驱动一件日常小仪器。
works.method: Photosynthesis and bacterial digestion in each container release electrons and protons that electrodes collect; the cells are wired together to reach the needed voltage.
works.method_zh: 每个容器中的光合作用和细菌分解释放出电子和质子，由电极收集；电池串联起来达到所需电压。

works.title: Zoe – A Living Sea Sculpture
works.description: A steel underwater sculpture four metres deep off Cozumel, Mexico, electrified so that limestone accretes on it and fragments of endangered coral can grow into a reef habitat.
works.description_zh: 一座位于墨西哥科苏梅尔岛外海 4 米深处的钢制水下雕塑，通电后表面沉积石灰岩，让濒危珊瑚碎片在上面生长成礁石栖息地。
works.idea_en: A sculpture can be designed to be finished by corals.
works.idea_zh: 一件雕塑可以被设计成由珊瑚来完成。
works.method: Mineral accretion (Biorock): a low-voltage current through the steel frame precipitates calcium carbonate from seawater, which corals attach to and grow faster on.
works.method_zh: 矿物增生（Biorock）技术：低压电流通过钢架，使海水中的碳酸钙沉淀下来，珊瑚附着其上并生长更快。

works.title: Bistro In Vitro
works.description: A fictional restaurant and online documentary serving imagined lab-grown meat dishes, such as knitted steak, to open a public debate on in-vitro meat before it reaches the market.
works.description_zh: 一家虚构餐厅和一部网络纪录片，端上想象中的实验室培养肉菜肴（比如“编织牛排”），在培养肉上市之前开启公众讨论。
works.idea_en: Design the menu before the technology arrives, so people can decide what they want from it.
works.idea_zh: 在技术到来之前先设计菜单，让人们决定想从中得到什么。
works.method: Speculative dishes and a cookbook built on cultured-meat research (muscle cells grown in bioreactors), produced with Submarine Channel.
works.method_zh: 基于培养肉研究（在生物反应器中培养肌肉细胞）的思辨菜肴和食谱，与 Submarine Channel 合作制作。

works.title: The Rise and Fall of Rayfish Footwear
works.description: A fake company that claimed to grow personalised sneakers from genetically engineered stingrays whose skin patterns customers could design online; the hoax and its staged collapse became a documentary.
works.description_zh: 一家假公司，声称用经过基因工程改造、皮纹可由顾客在线设计的魟鱼皮定制运动鞋；这场骗局和它被安排的倒闭后来拍成了纪录片。
works.idea_en: A convincing fiction can reveal how readily people accept engineered animals as products.
works.idea_zh: 一个足够逼真的虚构，可以揭示人们多么轻易地把工程动物当作商品接受。
works.method: Website, ads and videos for a fictional 'bio-customisation' service, run as a campaign with Ton Meijdam and Floris Kaayk and later revealed as design fiction.
works.method_zh: 为虚构的“生物定制”服务制作网站、广告和视频，与 Ton Meijdam、Floris Kaayk 合作开展，之后揭示为设计虚构。

works.title: Vegetal Transmutation
works.description: A series of contemplative charcoal drawings of part-human, part-plant beings made with philosopher Michael Marder on biodegradable envelopes holding London plane seeds, which are buried after the exhibition.
works.description_zh: 与哲学家 Michael Marder 合作的一组冥想式炭笔画，画的是半人半植物的生命，画在装有伦敦悬铃木种子的可降解信封上，展览结束后被埋入土中。
works.idea_en: An artwork can end its life as a seed bed.
works.idea_zh: 一件艺术品可以以苗床的形式结束它的生命。
works.method: Drawings on handmade biodegradable paper envelopes containing plane-tree seeds; after the show the envelopes are buried so the seeds can germinate.
works.method_zh: 画在手工可降解纸信封上，信封里装着悬铃木种子；展后把信封埋入土中，让种子发芽。

works.title: Vegetal Matrix
works.description: An installation that combines Kew botanical specimens and Wellcome manuscripts with paintings and hologram projections to address colonial extraction and honour Indigenous healing knowledge of plants.
works.description_zh: 一件装置，把邱园的植物标本、惠康收藏的手稿与绘画和全息投影结合，回应殖民掠夺，并向原住民关于植物的疗愈知识致敬。
works.idea_en: Plant archives can be restaged to credit the knowledge they took.
works.idea_zh: 植物档案可以被重新布置，归还它们所取走的知识的署名。
works.method: Commissioned installation with herbarium specimens, manuscripts, painted plant-spirit figures and holograms around medicinal plants such as mandrake.
works.method_zh: 委托创作的装置，围绕曼德拉草等药用植物，组合了标本、手稿、绘制的植物精灵形象和全息影像。

works.title: K-9_topology: Ecce Canis
works.description: The first part of the K-9_topology series: serotonin isolated from the blood of the artist and of her border collie Byron is combined into a scent that visitors can smell.
works.description_zh: 《K-9_topology》系列的第一部分：从艺术家和她的边境牧羊犬 Byron 血液中分离出血清素，合成为观众可以闻到的气味。
works.idea_en: Render a human–dog bond as a shared molecule you can smell.
works.idea_zh: 把人与狗的关系变成一种可以闻到的共同分子。
works.method: Serotonin was filtered from blood platelets with protein columns and chemically converted with indole into an odour.
works.method_zh: 用蛋白层析柱从血小板中过滤出血清素，再与吲哚一起化学转化为气味。

works.title: Primate Cinema: Apes as Family
works.description: A short drama made for chimpanzees, with actors in chimp costume, first screened to the chimpanzees at Edinburgh Zoo; the film cuts between the story and the apes watching it.
works.description_zh: 一部为黑猩猩拍摄的短剧，演员身穿黑猩猩服装，首映观众是爱丁堡动物园的黑猩猩；影片在剧情和观看它的猩猩之间来回剪辑。
works.idea_en: Design media for another species' attention, then watch them watching.
works.idea_zh: 为另一个物种的注意力设计媒介，再去看它们如何观看。
works.method: Plot and cues were developed with primatologists from chimp social behaviour; the film was shown on a large screen in the zoo enclosure and the audience was filmed.
works.method_zh: 剧情与细节依据黑猩猩的社会行为与灵长类学家共同设计，影片在动物园的展区里用大屏播放，同时拍下观众反应。

works.title: 1000 Handshakes
works.description: A performance in which the artist shakes more than a thousand hands while his palm is swabbed every 50 handshakes; sequencing shows how his hand microbiome changes, and the results become network portraits.
works.description_zh: 一场行为表演：艺术家与一千多人握手，每握 50 次就从手掌取样；测序结果显示他手部微生物组的变化，并被做成网络图肖像。
works.idea_en: A handshake is a microbial exchange; a self-portrait can be a changing microbiome.
works.idea_zh: 握手是一次微生物交换；自画像也可以是一个不断变化的微生物组。
works.method: Palm swabs were analysed by next-generation sequencing and the bacterial communities visualised with bioinformatic network software.
works.method_zh: 用高通量测序分析手掌拭子，再用生物信息学网络软件可视化细菌群落。

works.title: The Silkworm Project
works.description: A series of hybrid machines in which live silkworms spin self-organised 2D and 3D silk structures inside computer-controlled environments.
works.description_zh: 一系列混合机器：活蚕在计算机控制的环境里吐丝，自组织出二维和三维的丝结构。
works.idea_en: Use insect behaviour, not a loom, as the logic of a fabrication machine.
works.idea_zh: 用昆虫的行为而不是织机，作为制造机器的逻辑。
works.method: Bombyx mori larvae spin on stacked shelves and surfaces whose tilt, light and heat are adjusted by electronics in a feedback loop.
works.method_zh: 家蚕幼虫在层叠的格架和表面上吐丝，电子系统在反馈回路中调节倾角、光和温度。

works.title: Borderless Bacteria / Colonialist Cash
works.description: Banknotes from many countries are laid on nutrient agar in large Petri dishes; over weeks the microbes they carry grow over the portraits and symbols of national currency.
works.description_zh: 把多国钞票铺在大培养皿的营养琼脂上，几周内钞票携带的微生物慢慢覆盖钞票上的肖像和国家符号。
works.idea_en: Money is also a microbial medium that ignores borders.
works.idea_zh: 钱也是一种无视国界的微生物媒介。
works.method: Used banknotes are cultured on enriched agar and the growing bacterial and fungal colonies are viewed with light boxes and a digital microscope.
works.method_zh: 把用过的钞票放在营养琼脂上培养，用灯箱和数码显微镜观察生长的细菌和真菌菌落。

works.title: Anti-Marta
works.description: Artist Marta de Menezes and her partner, immunologist Luís Graça, exchanged small skin grafts so that each body made antibodies against the other; the work shows these antibodies as a record of mutual recognition.
works.description_zh: 艺术家 Marta de Menezes 与她的伴侣、免疫学家 Luís Graça 互换一小块皮肤移植，使彼此的身体产生针对对方的抗体；作品把这些抗体呈现为相互识别的记录。
works.idea_en: An immune rejection can also be a lasting form of recognition between two people.
works.idea_zh: 免疫排斥也可以是两个人之间一种持久的相互识别。
works.method: Reciprocal skin grafts between the couple triggered antibody production, which was isolated and displayed with video.
works.method_zh: 两人互相移植皮肤，引发抗体生成，再把抗体分离出来并配合影像展出。

works.title: Strange Encounters: Metaphysics, Algae and Carcinoma
works.description: A lab performance in which the artist brings together the single-celled alga Chlorella and human bladder carcinoma cells and documents their negotiation; in at least one case the cancer cells appeared to ingest the algae.
works.description_zh: 一场实验室表演：艺术家把单细胞藻类小球藻（Chlorella）与人类膀胱癌细胞放在一起，记录它们之间的“协商”；至少一次观察到癌细胞似乎吞下了藻类。
works.idea_en: Stage an encounter between plant and human cells to make biopower visible.
works.idea_zh: 让植物细胞与人类细胞相遇，使生命权力变得可见。
works.method: Co-culture of Chlorella and a human carcinoma cell line under microscope, performed and narrated by the artist.
works.method_zh: 在显微镜下共培养小球藻与人类癌细胞系，由艺术家现场操作并讲述。

works.title: PSX Consultancy
works.description: A fictional consultancy that designs devices to solve the pollination problems of six plant species, from prostheses that shake pollen onto visiting insects to floral 'sex toys'.
works.description_zh: 一家虚构的咨询公司，为六种植物的授粉难题设计装置，从把花粉抖落到来访昆虫身上的假体，到花朵的“情趣用品”。
works.idea_en: If pollinators vanish, what would it mean to design for a plant's sex life?
works.idea_zh: 如果传粉者消失，为植物的性生活做设计意味着什么？
works.method: Speculative objects designed with Pei Ying Lin, Dimitris Stamatis and Jasmina Weiss from the reproductive biology of specific plants.
works.method_zh: 与 Pei Ying Lin、Dimitris Stamatis 和 Jasmina Weiss 一起，依据具体植物的繁殖生物学设计思辨物件。

works.title: Meta_bolus
works.description: A lab installation built around the soil bacterium Streptomyces rimosus, which produces both antibiotics and geosmin, the smell of rain on soil; extracted antibiotics are returned to the earth while visitors breathe in the scent.
works.description_zh: 一件以土壤细菌 Streptomyces rimosus 为中心的实验室装置。这种细菌既产生抗生素，也产生雨后泥土的气味土臭素；提取出的抗生素被送回土壤，观众则吸入这股气味。
works.idea_en: Metabolism is an exchange of doses between species; ask whether we can smell antibiotic resistance.
works.idea_zh: 代谢是物种之间剂量的交换；我们能否闻到抗生素耐药性？
works.method: Streptomyces rimosus cultures are processed in lab glassware into two metabolites, antibiotics and geosmin, forming two linked loops.
works.method_zh: 在实验室玻璃器皿中处理 Streptomyces rimosus 培养物，得到抗生素和土臭素两种代谢物，形成两条相连的循环。

works.title: Et In Arcadia Ego
works.description: The artist grew colon tumour tissue from her own cells and shows it live in the gallery, confronting cancer as a material rather than a metaphor.
works.description_zh: 艺术家用自己的细胞培养出结肠肿瘤组织，并在展厅中展示活体，把癌症当作一种材料而不是隐喻来面对。
works.idea_en: Use tissue engineering to make mortality, not only enhancement, tangible.
works.idea_zh: 用组织工程让死亡变得可以触摸，而不只是增强。
works.method: Tumour tissue was grown in the lab from the artist's own intestinal cells with scientific collaborators; the exact protocol is not published.
works.method_zh: 与科学合作者一起，在实验室里用艺术家自己的肠道细胞培养出肿瘤组织；具体流程没有公开。

works.title: Host
works.description: An audience of about 200 live crickets in cages attends a scientific lecture on insect sex; one projection shows the lecturer, the other the oscilloscope trace recorded from the auditory nerve of a cricket listening to the talk.
works.description_zh: 约 200 只关在笼中的活蟋蟀一起“听”一场关于昆虫性生活的科学讲座；一面投影是讲者，另一面是从一只正在听讲的蟋蟀听觉神经上记录下的示波器信号。
works.idea_en: Use an animal's nervous system as the microphone and ask what it hears.
works.idea_zh: 把动物的神经系统当作麦克风，问它听到了什么。
works.method: Electrodes on the auditory nerve of a cricket recorded its response to the lecture, shown as an oscilloscope image with sound; the lecture was projected through insect cages.
works.method_zh: 在蟋蟀听觉神经上安放电极，记录它对讲座的反应，并以示波器图像和声音呈现；讲座影像透过昆虫笼投影。

works.title: Cryobook Archives
works.description: Small handmade books whose pages are human and pig skin tissue marked by a lentivirus, stored and shown in a portable freezer that works as a miniature library.
works.description_zh: 几本手工小书，书页是被慢病毒标记的人和猪的皮肤组织，存放并展示在一个像微型图书馆的便携冷冻柜里。
works.idea_en: Treat skin as a page and a virus as the ink.
works.idea_zh: 把皮肤当作书页，把病毒当作墨水。
works.method: Explant tissue and HaCaT skin cells were transfected with a lentiviral vector, stained immunohistochemically and bound using traditional bookbinding.
works.method_zh: 用慢病毒载体转染离体组织和 HaCaT 皮肤细胞，进行免疫组化染色，再用传统装订工艺成书。

works.title: Harlequin Coat
works.description: A prototype coat made of living skin cells of different origins, colours and ages, cultured in diamond-shaped Petri dishes, as a figure of cultural and biological crossbreeding.
works.description_zh: 一件原型外套，由不同来源、肤色和年龄的活皮肤细胞在菱形培养皿中培养而成，象征文化与生物的混杂。
works.idea_en: Stitch identity together from other people's living cells.
works.idea_zh: 用他人的活细胞拼出一个身份。
works.method: Skin cells from the artist and from donors of different backgrounds were grown in vitro at SymbioticA and arranged in a harlequin pattern.
works.method_zh: 在 SymbioticA 体外培养艺术家本人和不同背景捐赠者的皮肤细胞，并按丑角服的图案排列。

works.title: Operational Bodies: The Tomato Tasted Like Automation of Care
works.description: A long printed canvas on the facade of the Waag building shows a greenhouse tomato row as seen by the Plantalyzer robot, which photographs plants every night and uses AI to decide which tomatoes are ripe.
works.description_zh: Waag 大楼外立面上的一幅长幅印刷画，呈现 Plantalyzer 机器人眼中的一排温室番茄；这台机器人每晚拍摄植株，并用 AI 判断哪些番茄已经成熟。
works.idea_en: Show the machine view that now decides how crops are cared for.
works.idea_zh: 把如今决定作物如何被照料的机器视角公开出来。
works.method: Images captured by the robot's six cameras every 10 cm along 60 m of a tomato row in May 2022 were stitched and printed.
works.method_zh: 2022 年 5 月，机器人的六台摄像机沿 60 米番茄行每隔 10 厘米拍摄，图像拼接后打印。

works.title: The Condition
works.description: Cloned Nordmann fir Christmas trees rotate continuously in a machine that simulates microgravity, testing whether a tree bred and cloned for the market could survive changed conditions.
works.description_zh: 克隆的诺德曼冷杉圣诞树在模拟微重力的机器里持续旋转，测试这种为市场培育和克隆的树能否在变化的环境中存活。
works.idea_en: Treat a mass-cloned Christmas tree as a postnatural organism of the future forest.
works.idea_zh: 把大规模克隆的圣诞树当作未来森林中的后自然生物。
works.method: Genetically identical saplings from somatic embryogenesis at the University of Copenhagen are mounted on rotating clinostat-like rigs with lighting.
works.method_zh: 来自哥本哈根大学体细胞胚胎发生技术的同基因树苗，被装在带照明的类回转器旋转装置上。

works.title: Fly Printer – Extended
works.description: Fruit flies feeding on coloured food leave dots of excrement that form images; a camera and a convolutional neural network then look at the patterns and interpret them for a human audience.
works.description_zh: 果蝇吃下有颜色的食物，排泄的斑点形成图像；摄像头和卷积神经网络再观察这些图案，并向人类观众解释它们。
works.idea_en: Chain an insect, a machine and a person into one image-making system.
works.idea_zh: 把昆虫、机器和人串成一个制造图像的系统。
works.method: Drosophila live in a chamber with pigmented food over paper; a camera with a CNN classifies the resulting marks in real time.
works.method_zh: 果蝇生活在铺纸的箱体中，以含色素的食物为食；摄像头配合 CNN 实时识别留下的痕迹。

works.description: An installation built on bio-acoustic findings that plant roots respond to the sound of running water and emit ultrasonic clicks, speculating on how plants listen.
works.description_zh: 一件以生物声学发现为基础的装置：植物根系会对流水声作出反应，并发出超声波咔嗒声；作品借此想象植物如何“聆听”。
works.idea_en: Imagine a plant as a listener that follows the sound of water.
works.idea_zh: 把植物想象成一个追随水声的聆听者。
works.method: Speculative sound and video work based on published root bio-acoustics experiments (likely ultrasonic recordings of roots).
works.method_zh: 基于已发表的根系生物声学实验的思辨声音和影像作品（可能使用了根系的超声波录音）。

works.title: Wolfland
works.description: Part of the Jälestää – Tracing project: GPS tracks of a male wolf are laser-drawn on wood and acrylic, showing how the animal moves through and shapes a Finnish landscape.
works.description_zh: 《Jälestää – Tracing》项目的一部分：把一头公狼的 GPS 轨迹用激光刻在木板和亚克力上，呈现它如何穿越并塑造芬兰的景观。
works.idea_en: Draw a landscape from an animal's point of movement.
works.idea_zh: 从动物的移动出发绘制一片景观。
works.method: Satellite positioning data from a collared wolf was plotted and laser-engraved, combined with aerial and field footage.
works.method_zh: 把戴项圈的狼的卫星定位数据绘制成图并激光雕刻，结合航拍和实地影像。

works.title: Plastic Imaginaries
works.description: A speculative fiction film and installation about a ragpicker and a composter in a 'late plastic age', drawing on public events around plastiglomerates and mealworms that can biodegrade polystyrene.
works.description_zh: 一件思辨虚构影片与装置，讲述“晚期塑料时代”的拾荒者和堆肥者，素材来自围绕塑料砾岩和能降解聚苯乙烯的黄粉虫举办的公众活动。
works.idea_en: Imagine living with plastic through the organisms that can digest it.
works.idea_zh: 通过能消化塑料的生物，想象与塑料共处的生活。
works.method: Made with Åsa Ståhl from plastiglomerate walks and mealworm composting kits distributed to participants.
works.method_zh: 与 Åsa Ståhl 合作，素材来自塑料砾岩漫步活动和分发给参与者的黄粉虫堆肥套件。

works.title: Alive: A New Spatial Contract for Multi-Species Architecture
works.description: A walk-in room of textured, porous organic material designed to host many microclimates for microbes, with spaces for humans and micro-spaces for microbial communities side by side.
works.description_zh: 一个可走入的房间，由有纹理的多孔有机材料构成，为微生物提供多种微气候，人类空间与微生物群落的微空间并存。
works.idea_en: Design building surfaces for microbial diversity, a probiotic architecture.
works.idea_zh: 为微生物多样性设计建筑表面，即“益生菌建筑”。
works.method: Texture, light and air flow of the organic panels are calibrated to create varied microhabitats, with sampling of microbial communities.
works.method_zh: 调节有机板材的纹理、光线和气流，形成多样的微生境，并对微生物群落取样。

works.title: Magic Queen
works.description: A robotic garden of 3D-printed soil in which a robot arm tends fungal flora and plants, guided by sensors and machine learning; the plants and soil depend on the robot and vice versa.
works.description_zh: 一座以 3D 打印土壤建成的机器人花园：机械臂在传感器和机器学习的引导下照料真菌和植物，植物、土壤与机器人彼此依赖。
works.idea_en: Make a robot the gardener of a living, printed architecture.
works.idea_zh: 让机器人成为一座活的打印建筑的园丁。
works.method: Biodegradable soil structures were printed by an ABB IRB 2600 robot and tended by a second robot responding to sensor data.
works.method_zh: 用 ABB IRB 2600 机器人打印可降解的土壤结构，再由另一台机器人根据传感器数据进行照料。

works.title: Entangled Kingdoms
works.description: Fungal spores collected from two rooms of the Venice Arsenale were cultivated at the University of Athens and returned to the Biennale as a 'fungi garden' in a two-part installation.
works.description_zh: 从威尼斯军械库两个展厅采集的真菌孢子在雅典大学培养后，以“真菌花园”的形式回到双年展，构成两部分的装置。
works.idea_en: Reveal the fungi already living in the building and put them at the centre.
works.idea_zh: 揭示建筑中本就生活着的真菌，并把它们放到中心。
works.method: Air and surface samples from the exhibition rooms were cultured in a mycology lab and displayed as living cultures.
works.method_zh: 在展厅采集空气和表面样本，在真菌学实验室培养后作为活体培养物展出。

works.title: Atmospheric Forest
works.description: An immersive installation that visualises how the Pfynwald pine forest in the Swiss Alps breathes out volatile organic compounds under drought, based on data from a forest turned into a living observatory.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式装置，依据被改造为活体观测站的森林的数据，呈现瑞士阿尔卑斯 Pfynwald 松林在干旱下如何呼出挥发性有机化合物。
works.idea_en: Make the invisible breathing of trees under climate stress perceptible.
works.idea_zh: 让气候压力下树木看不见的呼吸变得可以感知。
works.method: VOC and tree-physiology data from Swiss research institute WSL are rendered as a 3D visualisation (also in VR).
works.method_zh: 把瑞士 WSL 研究所的 VOC 与树木生理数据渲染成三维可视化（也有 VR 版本）。

works.title: Swamp Observatory
works.description: A parasitic peat structure growing on the ZKM building with four instruments, including Swamp Brain, a hybrid of a swamp and an AI whose images are projected onto a dried ox bladder.
works.description_zh: 一座寄生在 ZKM 建筑上的泥炭结构，包含四件“仪器”，其中《Swamp Brain》把沼泽与 AI 结合，生成的图像投影在风干的牛膀胱上。
works.idea_en: Treat the swamp as an interface to Gaia and a model for multispecies thinking.
works.idea_zh: 把沼泽当作通往盖娅的界面，也当作多物种思考的模型。
works.method: Figures made of peat house smell, time-stack and AI modules; the AI was trained with scientist Jonas Kubilius on swamp forms.
works.method_zh: 以泥炭制成的造型内置气味、时间层和 AI 模块；AI 与科学家 Jonas Kubilius 一起用沼泽形态训练。

works.title: Perimeter Pfynwald – A Soundscape Observatory
works.description: A sound installation that compresses a summer of recordings from a drought-stressed Swiss pine forest, including a pond and soil fauna, into an audible model of the ecosystem.
works.description_zh: 一件声音装置，把一个受干旱影响的瑞士松林整个夏天的录音（包括池塘和土壤动物）压缩成可以聆听的生态系统模型。
works.idea_en: Listen to climate change as it happens inside a forest.
works.idea_zh: 聆听正在一片森林里发生的气候变化。
works.method: Autonomous recorders in the forest, the pond and the soil captured sound during the 2018 heat summer; the recordings were compressed in time and space.
works.method_zh: 2018 年热浪夏季，在森林、池塘和土壤中布置自动录音设备，录音在时间和空间上被压缩。

works.title: souvenirs entomologiques #1: odonata / weathering data
works.description: An installation that follows dragonflies from habitat to natural history museum to dataset, showing how insects become specimens, bioindicators and climate data.
works.description_zh: 一件装置，追踪蜻蜓从栖息地到自然史博物馆再到数据集的过程，呈现昆虫如何变成标本、生物指示物和气候数据。
works.idea_en: Trace the metamorphoses an insect undergoes as it becomes data.
works.idea_zh: 追踪一只昆虫在变成数据时所经历的“变态”。
works.method: Museum specimens, archival material and weathering data on Odonata are arranged as an installation.
works.method_zh: 把蜻蜓目的博物馆标本、档案材料和风化数据组织成一件装置。

works.title: TERRA XENOBIOTICA
works.description: An installation on soil at airports polluted by PFAS 'forever chemicals': 85 soil chromatograms made from earth with increasing PFAS doses hang on the wall, and visitors can place one under a scanner that reads the pollution.
works.description_zh: 一件关于机场土壤被 PFAS“永久化学品”污染的装置：墙上挂着 85 张用逐步加入 PFAS 的土壤制成的土壤色谱图，观众可以取下一张放到扫描仪下读取污染程度。
works.idea_en: Read soil as a living archive of the toxins that air travel leaves behind.
works.idea_zh: 把土壤读作一份活的档案，记录航空旅行留下的毒素。
works.method: Made during a residency at the Rillig Lab (Freie Universität Berlin): Pfeiffer-style paper chromatography of PFAS-spiked soils builds a dataset to train a neural network that recognises PFAS pollution.
works.method_zh: 在柏林自由大学 Rillig 实验室驻留期间完成：用 Pfeiffer 式纸色谱处理加入 PFAS 的土壤，建立数据集，训练识别 PFAS 污染的神经网络。

works.title: Werewool DNA-designed fibres
works.description: Textile fibres made from proteins whose sequences are borrowed from nature, for example a coral protein that gives colour without dye; the fibres are produced by engineered microbes and spun into yarn.
works.description_zh: 由借鉴自然蛋白序列的蛋白质制成的纺织纤维，例如一种无需染料就能显色的珊瑚蛋白；纤维由改造过的微生物生产，再纺成纱线。
works.idea_en: Pick the property you want from nature's protein library and grow it into the fibre.
works.idea_zh: 从自然的蛋白质库里挑选想要的性能，再把它“长”进纤维里。
works.method: Selected protein sequences are expressed in microbes by fermentation, purified and spun into fibres whose colour and texture come from the protein itself.
works.method_zh: 把挑选出的蛋白序列在微生物中通过发酵表达、纯化，再纺成纤维，颜色和质感来自蛋白本身。

works.title: TômTex leather alternative
works.description: A leather-like sheet made from chitosan taken from shrimp and crab shells and from mushroom waste, textured by embossing and finished without plastic coatings.
works.description_zh: 用从虾蟹壳和蘑菇废料中提取的壳聚糖制成的类皮革片材，通过压纹形成肌理，表面处理不使用塑料涂层。
works.idea_en: Shells from dinner plates and scraps from mushroom farms can replace plastic in synthetic leather.
works.idea_zh: 餐桌上的虾蟹壳和菇场的边角料可以替代合成皮革中的塑料。
works.method: Chitosan from seafood shells and fungal chitin is dissolved, cast into sheets with natural plasticisers and pigments, then embossed and dried.
works.method_zh: 把海鲜壳和真菌中的壳聚糖与甲壳素溶解，加入天然增塑剂和颜料浇铸成片，再压纹、干燥。

works.title: Celium
works.description: A leather-like material grown by bacteria as thick sheets of cellulose on a feedstock of fruit waste, then tanned-free finished for fashion, footwear and interiors.
works.description_zh: 由细菌以水果废料为原料长成厚厚的纤维素片材，再经过无鞣制的表面处理，用于时装、鞋履和室内设计的类皮革材料。
works.idea_en: Let bacteria weave the sheet, and use fruit waste as their food.
works.idea_zh: 让细菌“织”出片材，用水果废料当它们的食物。
works.method: Cellulose-producing bacteria ferment sugars from mango and other fruit waste in trays, forming a mat that is harvested, dried and finished.
works.method_zh: 产纤维素的细菌在托盘中发酵芒果等水果废料中的糖分，形成一层菌膜，收获后干燥并做表面处理。

works.title: Malai coconut-water biocomposite
works.description: A flexible, leather-like material made from bacterial cellulose grown on waste coconut water and reinforced with plant fibres such as banana, sisal or hemp; used for bags, wallets and shoes.
works.description_zh: 用废弃椰子水培养的细菌纤维素制成、并以香蕉、剑麻或大麻等植物纤维增强的柔韧类皮革材料，用于包袋、钱包和鞋子。
works.idea_en: A by-product that is poured away in coconut processing becomes the growth medium for a material.
works.idea_zh: 椰子加工中被倒掉的副产品，成了一种材料的生长基质。
works.method: Coconut water is fermented by bacteria that form cellulose mats; the mats are harvested, combined with natural fibres and dyed with natural pigments.
works.method_zh: 细菌发酵椰子水形成纤维素膜，收获后与天然纤维复合，并用天然色素染色。

works.title: MarinaTex
works.description: A translucent, home-compostable film made from fish scales and skins bound with red algae, proposed as a replacement for single-use plastic bags and packaging; it was shown in the Biofabricate 2019 Design Lab.
works.description_zh: 一种半透明、可在家庭堆肥的薄膜，由鱼鳞、鱼皮和红藻结合而成，用来替代一次性塑料袋和包装；曾在 Biofabricate 2019 的 Design Lab 展出。
works.idea_en: Waste from fish processing plus seaweed can do the job of a plastic bag.
works.idea_zh: 鱼类加工的废料加上海藻，就能完成塑料袋的工作。
works.method: Proteins extracted from fish scales and skin are mixed with agar from red algae as a binder, cast into sheets and dried at low temperature.
works.method_zh: 从鱼鳞和鱼皮中提取蛋白质，以红藻琼脂作为黏合剂混合，浇铸成片后低温干燥。

works.title: Bio Iridescent Sequin
works.description: Sequins made from wood-derived cellulose that shimmer through structural colour, with no pigment or plastic coating; shown in the Biofabricate 2019 Design Lab and at Dutch Design Week 2020.
works.description_zh: 由木材来源的纤维素制成的亮片，靠结构色闪烁，不用颜料或塑料涂层；曾在 Biofabricate 2019 的 Design Lab 和 2020 年荷兰设计周展出。
works.idea_en: Borrow the way beetles and butterflies make colour, and apply it to plant cellulose.
works.idea_zh: 借用甲虫和蝴蝶产生颜色的方式，把它用在植物纤维素上。
works.method: Cellulose nanocrystals in suspension self-assemble into helical layers as they dry, reflecting specific wavelengths of light; the films are then cut into sequins.
works.method_zh: 悬浮液中的纤维素纳米晶在干燥时自组装成螺旋层结构，反射特定波长的光，再把薄膜切成亮片。

works.title: Squitex
works.description: A protein fibre and textile coating modelled on the proteins in squid ring teeth; the material can heal small tears when wet and biodegrades, and was presented at Biofabricate 2022.
works.description_zh: 一种以鱿鱼吸盘环齿蛋白为模型的蛋白质纤维和纺织涂层；材料在湿润时可以修复细小撕裂并可生物降解，曾在 Biofabricate 2022 上介绍。
works.idea_en: Copy a molecular trick from a squid to make textiles that repair themselves and shed no plastic microfibres.
works.idea_zh: 借用鱿鱼的分子结构，让纺织品能自我修复，而且不掉塑料微纤维。
works.method: Protein sequences with repeating blocks inspired by squid ring teeth are produced by microbial fermentation and spun or coated onto fabric.
works.method_zh: 受鱿鱼吸盘环齿启发、带有重复片段的蛋白序列通过微生物发酵生产，再纺成纤维或涂覆到织物上。

works.title: Pure Human
works.description: A speculative project proposing leather grown from Alexander McQueen's DNA, extracted from hair in his 1992 graduate collection, shown through tattooed and freckled pigskin prototypes; exhibited in the Biofabricate 2016 Design Lab.
works.description_zh: 一个思辨项目，提出用 Alexander McQueen 的 DNA（取自其 1992 年毕业作品系列中的头发）培育皮革，并用带有纹身和雀斑的猪皮原型来呈现；曾在 Biofabricate 2016 的 Design Lab 展出。
works.idea_en: Genetic material can be patented and commercialised before the law protects the person it came from.
works.idea_zh: 在法律保护基因的主人之前，遗传材料就可能被申请专利并商业化。
works.method: Gorjanc filed a patent application for the process and used cured, tattooed pigskin to stand in for lab-grown human skin; likely no human tissue was cultured.
works.method_zh: Gorjanc 为这一工艺提交了专利申请，并用经过处理和纹身的猪皮代替实验室培养的人类皮肤；很可能并未真正培养人体组织。

works.title: Living Viral Tattoos
works.description: Sculptural prototypes of blue-brown 'bruises' made on pigskin and donated human skin with a non-pathogenic lentivirus, preserved in jars and shown in a glass case.
works.description_zh: 用一种非致病的慢病毒在猪皮和捐赠的人体皮肤上制造出蓝褐色“淤青”的雕塑原型，保存在罐中，陈列于玻璃展柜内。
works.idea_en: A virus can draw on skin, and the drawing only becomes visible through lab staining.
works.idea_zh: 病毒可以在皮肤上“作画”，而这幅画只有经过实验室染色才能被看见。
works.method: Skin samples were kept alive in tissue culture, infected with a replication-deficient lentiviral vector, and stained with immunohistochemistry so infected areas appear as coloured marks.
works.method_zh: 把皮肤样本放在组织培养中保持存活，用不能复制的慢病毒载体感染，再用免疫组化染色，让被感染的区域显出颜色。

paper.title: How to Make Living Viral Tattoos

works.title: The Martian Rose
works.description: A rose placed in a planetary simulation chamber at the Mars Simulation Laboratory, Aarhus University, and exposed to Martian temperature, pressure and atmosphere for six hours.
works.description_zh: 把一朵玫瑰放进丹麦奥胡斯大学火星模拟实验室的行星模拟舱，让它经受六小时的火星温度、气压和大气。
works.idea_en: The symbol of romantic love becomes a test subject for life beyond Earth.
works.idea_zh: 象征浪漫爱情的玫瑰，成了地外生命实验的受试者。
works.method: The artists worked with planetary scientists to run a standard Mars-simulation exposure on a cut rose and documented its changes.
works.method_zh: 艺术家与行星科学家合作，按标准火星模拟流程让一朵剪下的玫瑰接受暴露实验，并记录它的变化。

works.title: Fermenting Futures
works.description: A body of artworks with Alex May about yeast, made during a residency at the Institute of Microbiology and Microbial Biotechnology, BOKU Vienna, exploring how engineered yeast might help with environmental problems.
works.description_zh: 与 Alex May 合作的一组关于酵母的作品，在维也纳农业大学（BOKU）微生物与微生物技术研究所驻留期间完成，探讨工程酵母如何帮助应对环境问题。
works.idea_en: The organism that gave us bread and beer may also help with climate change.
works.idea_zh: 给我们带来面包和啤酒的生物，也许还能帮助应对气候变化。
works.method: The artists worked alongside BOKU's yeast researchers, likely including Pichia pastoris strains engineered to fix CO2, and combined cultures, textiles and sculpture into installation works.
works.method_zh: 艺术家与 BOKU 的酵母研究者一起工作，很可能用到了经过改造、能够固定二氧化碳的 Pichia pastoris 菌株，并把培养物、织物和雕塑组合成装置作品。

paper.title: Fermenting Futures: An Artistic Exploration of Yeast Biotechnology

works.title: Cybernetic Bacteria 2.0
works.description: An art-science project comparing bacterial quorum sensing with data packets on the internet, combining live bacterial cultures, embroidery and an interactive artificial-life simulation.
works.description_zh: 一个把细菌群体感应与互联网数据包相比较的艺术-科学项目，结合了活体细菌培养、刺绣和交互式人工生命模拟。
works.idea_en: Bacteria were networking long before we built the internet.
works.idea_zh: 早在人类建起互联网之前，细菌就在“联网”了。
works.method: Cultures of bacteria that signal by quorum sensing were grown and stitched into textiles, alongside software that models the signalling; built with a microbiologist, a philosopher and an artificial life programmer.
works.method_zh: 把依靠群体感应交流的细菌培养后缝进织物，同时配合模拟这种信号的软件；与微生物学家、哲学家和人工生命程序员合作完成。

works.title: Myx Sail
works.description: A large suspended acoustic sail of mycelium-textile panels installed in the Danish Design Museum in 2020; acoustic tests showed it lowered reverberation and improved speech clarity in the hall.
works.description_zh: 2020 年安装在丹麦设计博物馆的大型悬挂式声学“帆”，由菌丝体织物板组成；声学测试显示它降低了展厅混响，提高了语音清晰度。
works.idea_en: Grow sound absorbers from fungus and farm fibres instead of foam.
works.idea_zh: 用真菌和农业纤维“长”出吸声体，替代泡沫材料。
works.method: Mycelium is grown through layered woven jute, hemp mat and wood wool in moulds, bonding the fibres into light panels that are dried and hung on a cable frame.
works.method_zh: 让菌丝体在模具中穿过分层的黄麻织物、大麻毡和木丝生长，把纤维黏结成轻质板材，干燥后挂在索网框架上。

paper.title: Room acoustics of Mycelium Textiles: the Myx Sail at the Danish Design Museum

works.title: Phoenix (mycelium acoustic sculpture)
works.description: A room-filling sculpture of winding ribbons made entirely of mycelium composite, installed at the Charlotte Art League in 2023 and analysed as an acoustic retrofit for large rooms.
works.description_zh: 一件充满整个房间、由缠绕的带状构件组成的雕塑，完全用菌丝体复合材料制成，2023 年安装在夏洛特艺术联盟，并作为大空间的声学改造方案进行了分析。
works.idea_en: Mycelium can be grown flat, then shaped into large three-dimensional forms while it is still alive.
works.idea_zh: 菌丝体可以先平着长，再趁它还活着时塑造成大型立体形态。
works.method: Living myco-material is packed into flat formwork on a membrane, grown into flexible sheets, then hung and dried into computed ribbon geometries.
works.method_zh: 把活的菌丝材料填入铺在薄膜上的平面模板，长成柔性片材，再按计算生成的带状几何悬挂、干燥定形。

paper.title: Design, Cultivation, and Acoustic Analysis of a Building-Sized Mycelium Sculpture

works.title: BioForms
works.description: A two-metre wall-panel system whose recycled-plastic skin is 3D printed by a KUKA robot and filled with local waste that mycelium binds into a structural, insulating core.
works.description_zh: 一套两米高的墙板系统：外壳由 KUKA 机器人用回收塑料 3D 打印，内部填入本地废料，由菌丝体黏结成承重兼保温的芯层。
works.idea_en: Print the skin, let the fungus grow the core.
works.idea_zh: 外壳用打印，芯层让真菌去长。
works.method: An agent-based swarm algorithm arranges scale-like components on the printed PETG shell, which acts as sacrificial formwork for mycelium growing through packed waste substrate.
works.method_zh: 基于群体智能的算法在打印的 PETG 外壳上排布鳞片状构件，外壳作为牺牲模板，让菌丝体在压实的废料基质中生长。

paper.title: BioForms: 3-D printed mycelium wall panel systems

works.title: Fermenting Knits
works.description: Knitted and crocheted samples fused with bacterial cellulose that has been broken down into fibres and re-formed around the stitches, producing textile biocomposites.
works.description_zh: 把细菌纤维素打散成纤维，再让它围绕针脚重新成形，与针织和钩织样品融合，得到纺织生物复合材料。
works.idea_en: Bacterial cellulose can be treated as a fibre to rebuild with knitting, not only as a grown sheet.
works.idea_zh: 细菌纤维素可以当作能用针织重建的纤维，而不只是长出来的一张膜。
works.method: Bacterial cellulose pellicles are blended into a pulp, re-sheeted onto knit structures of different stitch and yarn types, and dried under controlled moisture.
works.method_zh: 把细菌纤维素膜打成浆，在不同针法和纱线的针织结构上重新成膜，再在控制湿度的条件下干燥。

paper.title: Fermenting knits: A material-driven exploration of knit-based bacterial cellulose biocomposite textile materials through fibre reassembly

works.title: Symbiocean: reef prototype Kiki
works.description: An artificial reef prototype woven by participants and installed ten metres underwater off Corsica, designed as a habitat for marine species in damaged 'blasted' seascapes rather than as a restoration of a pristine reef.
works.description_zh: 一个由参与者共同编织的人工礁原型，安装在科西嘉岛外十米深的水下，作为受损“破碎”海景中海洋物种的栖息地，而不是去复原一片原始珊瑚礁。
works.idea_en: Design for the reef that will be, not the one that was.
works.idea_zh: 为将要出现的礁石而设计，而不是为曾经的那片。
works.method: Conductive looms woven by volunteers form the structure, which is placed on the seabed at a marine research station; minerals and organisms are likely expected to accrete on it over time.
works.method_zh: 由志愿者编织的导电织架构成主体结构，放置在海洋研究站附近的海床上；预计矿物和生物会随时间在其上附着生长。

paper.title: Of other reefs: designing habitats in blasted seascapes

works.title: Cyanobacterial co-fabrication for architecture
works.description: A robotic fabrication workflow in which sand-based mixtures containing living cyanobacteria are deposited layer by layer and then hardened as the bacteria precipitate calcium carbonate.
works.description_zh: 一种机器人制造流程：含有活蓝细菌的沙基混合料被逐层沉积，随后蓝细菌析出碳酸钙，使其硬化。
works.idea_en: The robot lays down the shape; the bacteria finish the material.
works.idea_zh: 机器人铺出形状，细菌完成材料。
works.method: Synechococcus and Synechocystis strains are grown in sand–agar biomixtures, extruded by a robot into light-optimised geometries, and induce carbonate precipitation that binds the sand.
works.method_zh: 把 Synechococcus 和 Synechocystis 菌株培养在沙-琼脂生物混合料中，由机器人挤出成针对光照优化的几何形态，蓝细菌诱导碳酸盐沉淀，把沙粒黏结起来。

paper.title: Prototyping an additive co-fabrication workflow for architecture: utilizing cyanobacterial MICP in robotic deposition

works.title: Papier Plume (ImpressioVivo)
works.description: A lightweight foam made from paper waste that is hardened and made more fire-resistant by bacteria that grow calcite crystals through it, part of the ImpressioVivo research on 3D-printed, bacterially calcified materials.
works.description_zh: 一种用废纸制成的轻质泡沫，由细菌在其中生成方解石晶体，使其变硬并更耐火；属于 ImpressioVivo 项目中关于 3D 打印和细菌钙化材料的研究。
works.idea_en: Let soil bacteria mineralise waste paper into a stone-like foam.
works.idea_zh: 让土壤细菌把废纸矿化成像石头一样的泡沫。
works.method: Paper-waste foam is immersed in or sprayed with urease-producing bacteria and a calcium-urea solution in one or several steps, so calcite precipitates on the fibres.
works.method_zh: 把废纸泡沫浸入或喷上能产生脲酶的细菌以及钙-尿素溶液，分一步或多步处理，使方解石沉积在纤维上。

paper.title: Paper waste grown as a biocalcified foam: perspectives from a bacterial and design viewpoint

works.title: Kaumera Kimono
works.description: A kimono whose textile is treated with Kaumera, a biopolymer recovered from sewage-treatment bacteria, and dyed with colours from the same wastewater; shown at Dutch Design Week 2018.
works.description_zh: 一件和服，面料用 Kaumera 处理——这是一种从污水处理细菌中回收的生物聚合物——并用同一污水中提取的色素染色；2018 年荷兰设计周展出。
works.idea_en: Wastewater treatment can supply both the finish and the colour of a garment meant to last generations.
works.idea_zh: 污水处理厂既能提供面料整理剂，也能提供颜色，用来做一件可以代代相传的衣服。
works.method: Kaumera is extracted from the granular sludge bacteria of Dutch water boards; it helps fabric absorb dye, and pigments from anammox bacteria and vivianite are used for colour.
works.method_zh: Kaumera 从荷兰水务局污水处理中的颗粒污泥细菌里提取，可以提高织物的吸色能力；颜色来自厌氧氨氧化（anammox）细菌和蓝铁矿。

works.title: Blood Related
works.description: Objects made entirely from discarded cow blood from slaughterhouses, including a record that plays the animal's heartbeat and polished tiles that act as mirrors; first shown at the Design Academy Eindhoven Graduation Show during Dutch Design Week 2017.
works.description_zh: 完全用屠宰场废弃牛血制成的物件，包括一张播放这头牛心跳的唱片和被抛光成镜面的瓷砖；首次展出于 2017 年荷兰设计周期间的埃因霍温设计学院毕业展。
works.idea_en: Give a hidden waste stream a form, and the ethics of meat become something you can hold.
works.idea_zh: 给一种被隐藏的废料一个形状，肉食的伦理就成了可以拿在手里的东西。
works.method: Blood is dried and the protein is heat-pressed in moulds, where it binds without additives into a hard, dark, polishable material.
works.method_zh: 把血液干燥后，将其中的蛋白质在模具中热压，无需添加剂即可黏结成坚硬、深色、可抛光的材料。

works.title: Forest Wool
works.description: Stools, carpets, textiles and paper made from pine needles, the 20–30 percent of a pine tree's mass that forestry discards; developed as Orjola's Design Academy Eindhoven graduation project (2016).
works.description_zh: 用松针制成的凳子、地毯、织物和纸——松针占松树质量的 20% 到 30%，却在林业中被丢弃；这是 Orjola 在埃因霍温设计学院的毕业项目（2016）。
works.idea_en: The part of the tree we throw away can become a fibre industry.
works.idea_zh: 树上被我们丢掉的那部分，可以成为一个纤维产业。
works.method: Needles are crushed, soaked, steamed, carded and bound or pressed with standard techniques, producing fibre, composite panels and paper while extracting essential oil and dye along the way.
works.method_zh: 用常规工艺把松针压碎、浸泡、蒸煮、梳理，再黏合或压制，得到纤维、复合板材和纸，同时提取精油和染料。

works.title: Biohybrid Devices
works.description: Interactive devices, such as a game controller, whose bodies are grown from a living SCOBY biofilm that encloses the electronic components as it forms; published at UIST 2023 and exhibited at Dutch Design Week 2024.
works.description_zh: 由活的 SCOBY 生物膜“长”出外壳的交互设备（例如一个游戏手柄），生物膜在生长时把电子元件包裹进去；论文发表于 UIST 2023，并在 2024 年荷兰设计周展出。
works.idea_en: Grow the housing of a device around its electronics instead of moulding plastic.
works.idea_zh: 让设备外壳围绕电子元件生长出来，而不是用塑料模压。
works.method: Circuits and sensors are placed on a scaffold in a kombucha culture; the bacteria and yeast grow a cellulose biofilm over them, which is then dried into a flexible, functional casing.
works.method_zh: 把电路和传感器放在康普茶培养液中的支架上，细菌和酵母在其上长出一层纤维素生物膜，干燥后成为柔韧且能工作的外壳。

paper.title: Biohybrid Devices: Prototyping Interactive Devices with Growable Materials

works.title: Mycelium Pigeon Towers
works.description: Towers for feral city pigeons built from bricks of living mycelium waste from an oyster-mushroom farm; an ongoing experiment with Mediamatic, one tower was built on site at Dutch Design Week 2021 within MU's Hara Hachi Bu Village.
works.description_zh: 用平菇农场的活菌丝废料砖块为城市野鸽建造的塔；这是与 Mediamatic 合作的持续实验，2021 年荷兰设计周期间在 MU 的“Hara Hachi Bu Village”现场建造了其中一座。
works.idea_en: Temporary architecture for non-humans can be grown from the waste of our food.
works.idea_zh: 为非人类而建的临时建筑，可以用我们食物生产的废料来“长”。
works.method: Spent mushroom substrate still colonised by mycelium is packed into bricks and stacked; the mycelium grows the bricks together while fungi fruit on the surface and birds move in.
works.method_zh: 把仍被菌丝占据的废弃菌棒基质压成砖块堆砌起来，菌丝把砖块长在一起，蘑菇在表面出菇，鸽子随后入住。

works.title: BIO Plexis
works.description: A knitted wearable made from home-made bio-yarns infused with bioactive marine algae, meant to nourish the skin and stay 'alive' for a set period; shown at Dutch Design Week 2020.
works.description_zh: 一件用自制生物纱线针织而成的可穿戴物，纱线中注入了具有生物活性的海藻，用来滋养皮肤，并在一段时间内保持“活着”；2020 年荷兰设计周展出。
works.idea_en: A garment can be cared for like a living thing, with a lifespan designed in.
works.idea_zh: 衣服可以像生命一样被照料，并被设计出一个寿命。
works.method: An algae-laden biopolymer is extruded into yarn-like strands and hand-knitted into a garment that is kept hydrated to keep the algae active.
works.method_zh: 把含藻类的生物聚合物挤出成纱线状，再手工编织成衣物，并保持湿润以维持藻类的活性。

works.title: Kapitän Biopunk: Fermentation Madness
works.description: A series of workshops and an acoustic, performative installation that teaches people to ferment safe, affordable alcohol with DIY and open-source tools, made in response to deaths from toxic bootleg liquor in Indonesia; shown in the SIGGRAPH 2012 Art Gallery.
works.description_zh: 一系列工作坊和一件声音表演装置，用 DIY 和开源工具教人们安全、廉价地发酵酒精，回应印度尼西亚因私酿毒酒导致的死亡事件；曾在 SIGGRAPH 2012 艺术画廊展出。
works.idea_en: Open the lab: fermentation knowledge can be a public-health tool.
works.idea_zh: 打开实验室：发酵知识可以成为公共卫生工具。
works.method: Participants ferment sugars with yeast in home-built vessels, and the fermentation set-up is played as an acoustic installation, likely by amplifying and processing its bubbling; the workshops share recipes and safety checks.
works.method_zh: 参与者用自制容器以酵母发酵糖分，发酵装置本身被作为声音装置来演奏，很可能是放大并处理发酵冒泡的声音；工作坊分享配方和安全检测方法。

works.title: Normal Flora (Bed Flora, Plate Flora, Table Flora)
works.description: Prints and objects showing the harmless bacteria that live on everyday things in the artist's home, such as her bed, plates and table, grown and photographed from swabs; the prints were shown in the SIGGRAPH 2005 Art Gallery.
works.description_zh: 展示艺术家家中床铺、盘子、桌子等日常物品上无害细菌的版画和物件，细菌由拭子取样后培养并拍摄；这组版画曾在 SIGGRAPH 2005 艺术画廊展出。
works.idea_en: Every surface at home is a landscape of microbes we never see.
works.idea_zh: 家里的每一个表面，都是我们看不见的微生物景观。
works.method: Swabs from household objects are cultured on agar with microbiologists, then photographed through microscopy and printed; later works embed cultures in textiles and crochet.
works.method_zh: 与微生物学家合作，把家居物品上的拭子样本在琼脂上培养，再通过显微摄影拍摄并印刷；后续作品还把培养物嵌入织物和钩织中。

works.title: Microbiospheric Engineering
works.description: A clear sphere coated with sculpted agar on which human-seeded bacteria spread alongside wild microbes, while an automated microscope surveys the growth like a satellite over a planet; shown in the SIGGRAPH Asia 2021 Art Gallery.
works.description_zh: 一个透明球体，表面覆盖着雕塑成地形的琼脂，人类接种的细菌与野生微生物在上面一起扩张，同时一台自动显微镜像卫星俯瞰行星一样巡视这些生长；曾在 SIGGRAPH Asia 2021 艺术画廊展出。
works.idea_en: A petri dish shaped like a planet makes population growth and resource depletion visible in days.
works.idea_zh: 把培养皿做成行星的形状，几天之内就能看到种群增长和资源耗竭。
works.method: Bacterial colonies are seeded onto an agar landscape on a transparent sphere; a robotic microscope images them daily and presents the images as satellite-style maps.
works.method_zh: 把细菌菌落接种到透明球体上的琼脂地形中，机器人显微镜每天拍摄，并以卫星地图的形式呈现。

works.title: Zeefier seaweed dyes
works.description: Natural textile dyes made entirely from seaweed such as bladderwrack and from seaweed waste streams, shown on scarves and rugs at Dutch Design Week 2021.
works.description_zh: 完全用墨角藻等海藻及其废料制成的天然纺织染料，2021 年荷兰设计周上以围巾和地毯的形式展出。
works.idea_en: Seaweed needs no farmland or fresh water, and it can colour textiles.
works.idea_zh: 海藻不需要耕地和淡水，还能给织物上色。
works.method: Pigments are extracted from harvested seaweed and seaweed residues and applied to natural fibres with mordants, likely also derived from seaweed.
works.method_zh: 从收获的海藻及其残渣中提取色素，再配合媒染剂（很可能也来自海藻）染到天然纤维上。

works.title: Microbial Oasis: Architecture for Microorganisms
works.description: Speculative 3D-printed habitats for bacteria and algae made from silk and bone mineral seeded with human stem cells, proposing people as 'donors' who grow refuges for threatened microbial life; shown at Dutch Design Week 2024.
works.description_zh: 用丝素蛋白和骨矿物 3D 打印、并接种人类干细胞的细菌与藻类栖息地；这一思辨设计提出人类可以成为“捐赠者”，为受威胁的微生物生长出庇护所；2024 年荷兰设计周展出。
works.idea_en: What if conservation meant growing part of your own body as a home for microbes?
works.idea_zh: 如果保护自然意味着用你身体的一部分为微生物建一个家呢？
works.method: Scaffolds modelled on the cell structure of sphagnum moss are bioprinted from silk fibroin and hydroxyapatite, seeded with stem cells that develop into bone tissue, and offered to bacteria and algae.
works.method_zh: 以泥炭藓的细胞结构为模型，用丝素蛋白和羟基磷灰石生物打印支架，接种可分化为骨组织的干细胞，再提供给细菌和藻类栖居。

works.title: Cellular Propeller
works.description: An ongoing bio-art project that tries to make living cells turn a tiny synthetic propeller, first with contracting heart-muscle cells and later with the artist's own sperm racing around a spinning disc; the sperm proposal was debated before an ethics panel at Waag's Trust Me, I'm an Artist in 2016.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的生物艺术项目：尝试让活细胞推动一个微小的人造螺旋桨，起初用会收缩的心肌细胞，后来改为用艺术家自己的精子绕着旋转圆盘赛跑；2016 年这个精子方案在 Waag 的 Trust Me, I'm an Artist 活动上接受了伦理小组的讨论。
works.idea_en: Cells can be put to work as tiny motors, which raises the question of whose cells and for what.
works.idea_zh: 细胞可以被当作微型马达来驱动东西，而这马上引出问题：用谁的细胞、为了什么。
works.method: Living motile or contractile cells are placed on a synthetic moulded disc so their movement spins it, developed during a lab residency at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg.
works.method_zh: 把会运动或收缩的活细胞放在人造模具圆盘上，靠它们的运动让圆盘转动；最初的实验在海德堡德国癌症研究中心（DKFZ）的实验室驻留中完成。
